captions.detailed: A twin-globe candy vending machine featuring two transparent spherical bowls mounted side-by-side on a red metal housing atop a gray base. Each clear bowl is capped with a red lid featuring a small silver hinge, and sits on a cylindrical support containing colorful spherical candies. A shared gray collection tray with a clear flap is positioned at the front, flanked by two individual black dispensing knobs that rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a countertop dual-globe candy dispenser using CadQuery. The model should feature a shared gray base, a red main body supporting two side-by-side transparent spherical globes with red hinged lids, and a central front collection bin with a clear hinged door, flanked by two independent rotating dispensing knobs.
captions.factory: Construct the main base using a Box primitive, and create the red body housing using a combined Box and Cylinder design. Model the two transparent globes using Sphere primitives, combined with cylindrical supports, and top them with thin Cylinder lids. Build the collection cup as a hollowed Box, adding a transparent Box for the hinged front door, and model the two side knobs using Cylinders with small knobs on the ends.
